scope: Deterministic offline JPEG size and Pillow software-decode RGB8 PSNR; no timing or hardware measurement

source.selection: first 60 unique native-decoded frames; no resampling or looping

method.canvas: production host.canvas(frame), aspect-preserving fit into centered 720x405 viewport on RGB 720x480 canvas
method.encoder: production msv1.encode_receiver_jpeg with its unchanged receiver JPEG profile
method.decoder: Pillow software JPEG decode to RGB8
method.psnr: RGB8 mean squared error over all channels; exact scaled content rectangle, active viewport rows 37:442 including side bars, and full 720x480 canvas are reported separately
method.application_udp_bytes: JPEG bytes plus one production MSV1 header per 1024-byte payload chunk
method.rate_values: nominal average bitrate demand from these 60 frames at 20 or 30 fps; not achieved throughput

limitations: Pillow software decode is not FPGA decoded-pixel evidence.
PSNR is a numerical image-difference metric, not human visual assessment.
Nominal rate demand is not proof that a sender, link, receiver or display can sustain the rate.
